content: {"praised":["Stunning animation and breathtaking art quality.","Excellent voice acting in both Japanese and English.","Engaging characters and strong emotional attachment.","Well-crafted music and theme songs.","No filler episodes, tight storytelling."],"criticized":["Writing felt messy and rushed.","Story execution left something to be desired.","Pacing issues in middle and end.","Some fan service considered excessive.","Limited depth in some themes."]}
